Panda’s Missing Puzzle

Age 4–5 YearsClass 30 · LogicSkill Missing pieces

A wing, a roof, a wheel — find the piece that completes each of Panda’s pictures.

Play the puzzle game ↓Print the worksheet ↓Play with a finger, a stylus or a mouse. Instructions are spoken aloud.
PLAY · MISSING PIECES

Panda’s Missing Puzzle

Each picture is missing a piece! Tap the piece that completes it.

The butterfly is missing a piece. Tap it!

The house is missing a piece. Tap it!

The train is missing a piece. Tap it!

All puzzles complete!

A wing for the butterfly, a roof for the house, a wheel for the train.

FOR GROWN-UPS

Why this adventure helps.

This game trains missing pieces on the puzzle picture itself: the question is spoken aloud, the answers are pictures, and a miss brings a gentle hint instead of a penalty. Ask your child to explain the rule out loud — saying the “why” is the whole skill.

Illustration note: The Canva title reads "Panda’s Mising Puzzle" — a missing S. The site always shows the corrected spelling; the artwork itself is reported for regeneration.

Prefer paper? The Panda’s Missing Puzzle worksheet prints the same puzzle with room to draw, sort and circle — and a grown-up answer line. Printing never marks anything complete.
